call_points.text: Aims for 75-80% EBITDA margin in Lemon Tree's asset-light business over the next 3-4 years.
Signed 13 managed/franchised hotels with 1,020 rooms in Q1, over 3x the rooms opened.
Keys portfolio RevPAR up 19% YoY to ₹2,885, with occupancy at 67% and ARR at ₹4,311.
Gross debt at ₹1,475 Cr, down 11% YoY; cost of debt at 7.48%, down 53 bps.
Mumbai and Gurgaon markets underperformed due to corporate demand softness and new supply; recovery expected in Q2.
Fleur and Warburg Pincus can deploy up to ₹3,000 Cr in acquisitions and development over 12-18 months.
Reiterated reduction in GST, tech, and renovation friction to 4.8% of revenue in FY27 and ~3.7% in FY28.
FY26 gross ARR reached ₹6,875 and occupancy reached 73.5%, highest full-year levels in company history.
Total borrowings declined to ₹1,500 Cr from ₹1,699 Cr YoY, with borrowing costs dropping 115 bps to 7.42%.
Signed 55 managed/franchised hotels (4,912 rooms) and opened 20 hotels (1,523 rooms) in FY26; expects ~2,000 rooms opened in FY27.
Middle East geopolitical conflict hurt corporate travel and airport micro-markets in March-April, offset by retail pricing.
Demerger timeline estimated at 12 to 18 months depending on NCLT court process.
Fleur plans to open 2 of 3 blocks at Aurika Naldehra, Shimla by Q2 FY27.
Renovation, tech, and GST changes impacted FY26 EBITDA margin by 580 bps, expected to moderate to ~3.7% by FY28.

In this matter, on the request of the Hind Inns & Hotels, Hon’ble High Court vide its order dated 14.10.2025 referred the parties to mediation before the Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre. The matter is now listed on 06.08.2026.

operating_notes.text: Signed license agreements for Lemon Tree Premier, Raipur (78 rooms) and Lemon Tree Hotel, Jalandhar (60 rooms), to be managed by Carnation Hotels Private Limited.
Opened Lemon Tree Premier, Biratnagar in Nepal, featuring 80 rooms as the company's third operational hotel in the country.
Signed licence agreement for Lemon Tree Hotel, Ahilyanagar (95 rooms), managed by Carnation Hotels; Maharashtra portfolio now 30 properties, 15 operational and 15 in the pipeline.
Group operates 130+ hotels across 80+ cities with a pipeline of 130+ upcoming properties, and 250+ properties operational and upcoming since its first 49-room hotel in 2004.
Opened Keys Select by Lemon Tree Hotels, Amritsar, featuring 50 rooms.
Opened Lemon Tree Hotel, Bhubaneswar, featuring 65 rooms.
Opened Keys Select by Lemon Tree Hotels, Chirang (40 rooms), marking the group's first property in Assam.
Signed licence agreement for Lemon Tree Hotel, Satya Nagar, Bhubaneswar (50 rooms), managed by Carnation Hotels; third property in Bhubaneswar, ~5.4 km from the airport.

Signed franchise agreement for Keys Prima by Lemon Tree Hotels, Karnal (50 rooms), ~4.2 km from Karnal Railway Station and ~127 km from Chandigarh airport; Haryana portfolio at 13 hotels (11 operational, 2 upcoming).
Signed license agreement for Lemon Tree Hotel, Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu (66 rooms), to be managed by Carnation Hotels Private Limited.
Coastal Cedar Investments B.V. acquired a 41.09% equity stake in material subsidiary Fleur Hotels Limited.
Cost of borrowing stood at 7.42% as of 31 March 2026, down 115 bps YoY.
Third-party management fees reached ₹73.9 Cr in FY26 (+23% YoY).
Total room pipeline stands at 22,581 rooms across 268 hotels, with 11,811 rooms across 131 hotels operational.
FY26 management fees from third-party hotels grew 23% YoY to ₹73.9 Cr; fees from Fleur grew 8% YoY to ₹95.8 Cr.
Aurika Nehru Place in Delhi will feature 572 keys as North India's largest hotel.
Signed franchise agreement for Keys Prima by Lemon Tree Hotels, Jaipur, adding 88 rooms and taking the city portfolio to six properties.
Keys portfolio RevPAR was ₹2,885 in Q1FY27, up 19% YoY, with occupancy at 67% and ARR at ₹4,311.
Network revenue grew 16% YoY to ₹576 Cr, with owned hotels contributing ₹320 Cr and managed/franchised ₹256 Cr.
Fee income from third-party hotels was ₹22.8 Cr (up 42% YoY) and from Fleur ₹22.6 Cr (up 6% YoY).
Signed a franchise agreement for a 52-room Keys Select hotel in Bareilly, adding its 26th property in Uttar Pradesh.
Signed an MOU with Omaxe Limited to operate ~4,000 keys across transit hubs, pilgrimage destinations, and commercial districts.
Signed a license agreement for Keys Lite by Lemon Tree Hotels, Bhilwara, featuring 63 rooms, managed by subsidiary Carnation Hotels.

timeline.summary: Lemon Tree Hotels signed two license agreements for properties in Raipur (78 rooms) and Jalandhar (60 rooms) to be managed by Carnation Hotels.
April 30, 2026: Lemon Tree Hotels mutually terminated the operating and license agreements for Lemon Tree Hotel, Tarudhan Valley, Manesar.
Lemon Tree Hotels opened Lemon Tree Premier, Biratnagar, adding its third operational property in Nepal with 80 rooms.

May 5, 2026: Lemon Tree Hotels signed a licence agreement for Lemon Tree Hotel, Ahilyanagar (95 rooms, Maharashtra), managed by Carnation Hotels, taking its Maharashtra portfolio to 30 properties (15 operational, 15 pipeline).
Lemon Tree Hotels opened Keys Select in Amritsar with 50 rooms.
Lemon Tree Hotels opened a 65-key hotel in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, marking its second property in the city.
May 15, 2026: Lemon Tree Hotels entered Assam by opening the 40-room Keys Select in Chirang, managed by Carnation Hotels.
May 15, 2026: Lemon Tree Hotels signed a licence agreement for Lemon Tree Hotel, Satya Nagar, Bhubaneswar (50 rooms), managed by Carnation Hotels, its third property in the city.
May 18, 2026: Lemon Tree Hotels signed a franchise agreement for Keys Prima by Lemon Tree Hotels, Karnal (50 rooms), taking its Haryana footprint to 13 hotels (11 operational, 2 upcoming).
Lemon Tree Hotels consummated the 41.09% stake transfer in subsidiary Fleur Hotels to coastal Cedar Investments B.V. on May 22, 2026.
Lemon Tree Hotels signed a license agreement for a 66-room hotel in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu, managed by Carnation Hotels.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹416.4 Cr (+10.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹91.49 Cr (+8.1% YoY).
Lemon Tree Hotels presented its Q4 & FY26 results and detailed its proposed composite scheme to demerge and list Fleur Hotels.
Lemon Tree Hotels Limited held an Investors Conference Call on Audited Financial Results for Q4 & FY2026 on May 29, 2026, with audio recording available at the company’s website.
Lemon Tree held Q4FY26 earnings call, outlining Fleur demerger roadmap, potential ₹3,000 Cr deployment, and steady-state 60% PAT margin for pure-play Lemon Tree.
Lemon Tree Hotels signed a franchise agreement for an 88-room Keys Prima hotel in Jaipur, bringing its portfolio in the city to six properties.

On August 10, 2026, Lemon Tree Hotels held its Q1 FY27 earnings call, reporting revenue of ₹346.8 Cr (up 9% YoY) and net EBITDA margin of 43.8% (down 99 bps), and guiding to a 50% net EBITDA margin in FY28.
Lemon Tree Hotels signed a franchise agreement for a 52-room Keys Select hotel in Bareilly, taking its total properties in Uttar Pradesh to 26.
On October 16, 2026, Lemon Tree Hotels announced that its subsidiary Carnation Hotels signed an MOU with Omaxe Limited to operate ~4,000 keys.

On October 16, 2026, Lemon Tree Hotels announced that its material subsidiary Fleur Hotels received a favorable partial appellate order from the CGST Commissioner dropping interest liability on irregular ITC.
On October 23, 2026, Lemon Tree Hotels announced the signing of a license agreement for a 63-room Keys Lite hotel in Bhilwara, Rajasthan.
